items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: He bought the parts from Peterson, who all musicians used to go by at that time.

ctx.x: See, wait, you, you said there were a lot of, what other clubs were across the river?

Uh, the Moulin Rouge was one, I remember, I remember, I believe it was called Specs or something. Mm-hmm, yeah. Specs was on the air. And there was a Moonlight Inn. Yeah. That's, those two I remember. Mm-hmm. Because one of them had a windmill. Well, that's the Moulin Rouge. Oh, okay. Yeah, I see. Specs had glasses. It seemed like it was. But it was, uh, um, uh, a windmill was a neon lighted windmill. Mm-hmm. I remember that much, because it was the first excitement of the first time playing indoors. And I played…
What's the difference? Or is it?
